topic: JPEG XL and practical image delivery
angle: Image formats alone do not fix web performance; responsive sizing, lazy loading and fallbacks matter
problem: Large or unnecessary image downloads slow frontend pages
mechanism: srcset and sizes, loading lazy, picture fallbacks, and LCP measurement

angle: Search pagination correctness requires stable ranking and deterministic ordering
problem: Duplicate or missing search results across consecutive pages
mechanism: Replica scoring differences, stable relevance scoring, unique tie-breakers and cursor pagination

angle: Measure full request latency before optimizing MongoDB queries
problem: Slow API responses can originate outside database execution
mechanism: Distributed tracing with request context, spans, database timing and OpenTelemetry

angle: Use AI-generated prototypes to learn system requirements, then deliberately simplify architecture and tests
problem: AI-generated prototypes can become production systems without developers understanding the design
mechanism: Exploratory prototype followed by architecture review, focused refactoring, risk-based testing and verification

topic: Gemini 4 Argon and model upgrade contract tests
angle: Evaluate new models against application schemas, latency, cost and failure cases rather than benchmarks
problem: A model upgrade can degrade existing application behaviour despite stronger benchmarks
mechanism: Representative test inputs, strict schema validation, cost and latency comparisons, staged rollout and rollback

topic: Google Developer Knowledge API and current documentation for coding agents
angle: Retrieve version-specific official API documentation before generating integrations, then validate against live contracts
problem: AI-generated integrations may use deprecated endpoints or obsolete SDK assumptions
mechanism: Official documentation retrieval through MCP, version checks, and focused API integration tests
